Key points
• Indirect calorimetry assesses the rate of metabolic heat production based on the rates of consumption of oxygen and
production of carbon dioxide and nitrogen waste products.
• In nutrition, indirect calorimetry typically referring to a measurement of respiratory gas exchange across the lungs.
• Indirect calorimetry is used to optimize nutrition therapy of hospitalized patients and determine the cardiovascular ﬁtn
